result:
I fixed the duplicate deliveries in `src/lib/event-bus.ts`. I haven't run the test suite or a detach/re-attach cycle, so the fix is untested.

`subscribe()` copies the handler set each time it adds a handler. The function it returned to detach kept a reference to the set that existed when it was created. Once later subscribes replaced that set, detaching deleted from an old copy and the live set kept the handler. After a detach and re-attach, the old handlers were still attached alongside the new ones. That is the duplicate webhooks, audit rows and usage increments.

The detach function now looks up the current set for that event type. It removes the handler from a fresh copy and stores that copy, so it stays copy-on-write. Detaching twice does nothing.

I made no changes to registering twice without detaching (`registerEventHandlers()` already skips that) or to in-app notifications (`notification-service.ts` attaches its handlers once and never detaches them). Both should behave as you described.
